claims.text: INAH describes Tenochtitlan’s palaces and reconstruction after Spanish and Indigenous conquest. At the actual Oaxaca city site, it names an alcalde mayor with villa and cabildo-lot duties; Cortés’s attempted annexation failed. Capital reconstruction and a specified settlement office are different relations. These retrospectives do not establish empty land, universal Indigenous consent or later city titles.

recall.question: Why cannot one conquest label supply both local institutions?
options: Capital reconstruction differed from an alcalde’s villa and cabildo-lot duties.
Conquest gave both sites identical offices and duties.
